text:
Maya - Sales: Quick help — DeltaFinance POC hit ~100rps and started getting 5xxs, demo in 30m. Need triage.
Rohit (eng): can you share a request id and model?
Maya - Sales: req-id d-44aa55bb, model=rwd-large, window ~13:12-13:14 UTC.
AutoScaleBot: autoscaler event: scale_up requested at 13:11:58 UTC -> new target gpupool-4 (pending).
Tess (ops): pulling logs for d-44aa55bb. Ask customer to replay with X-Request-ID header so we can correlate.
Maya - Sales: replayed, logs:```
[2026-06-02T13:12:05Z] d-44aa55bb worker=gpupool-2 error=502 upstream="kv-cache OOM"
[2026-06-02T13:12:05Z] throttled=true queue_len=1203 autoscale_pending=16s
```
Rohit (eng): root cause looks like kv cache pressure -> OOM on rwd-large plus request backlog. Autoscaler lag ~16s.
Tess (ops): checking routing rules — DeltaFinance has custom policy disallowing burstpool for data-region reasons. That's why fallback didn't trigger.
Maya - Sales: customer insists on guaranteed capacity for the demo. Options?
Tess (ops): short-term: we can temporarily allow burst-fallback for the org for the demo window or provision a short reserved burst (hourly charge). I'll enable a temporary override now.
Tess (ops): override applied -> fallback allowed to gpupool-burst and compatible variant rwd-medium.
Maya - Sales: client re-ran 3m later -> error rate down to ~0.2%, demo passed. :tada:
Rohit (eng): follow-ups: 1) ensure routing rules for POC orgs permit emergency fallback unless explicitly requested otherwise, 2) increase kv-cache for rwd-large for POC traffic, 3) add alert when queue_len > 1000 and autoscale_pending > 10s.
Tess (ops): I'll open a ticket for the autoscale warm-pool change and share pricing DM for reserved bursts.
Maya - Sales: thanks — sending the minimal log excerpt to customer:```
2026-06-02T13:12:05Z d-44aa55bb error=502 "kv-cache OOM"; throttled=true; autoscale_pending=16s; fallback_blocked_by_policy
```
Maya - Sales: will confirm if they want a reserved burst next week. Thanks all :thumbsup:
